policy.credential_scan: High-confidence provider key formats only; matched values never serialized. Non-test source matches are held.
policy.binary_payloads: No binary content; any binary marker is recorded.
policy.data_scope: RAW, production data, dependency/build outputs and generated GitHub Pages payload excluded.
policy.gh_pages: History retained via parent merge; generated tree payload omitted.
policy.patch_format: Git unified text diff, full blob indexes, no rename detection, 3 context lines. Every base/tip SHA and path denominator pinned; identical patch bytes deduplicated by SHA256.

delivery_note: Paths refer to this delivered package; archive-embedded metadata preserves the original authoring snapshot.
